title: GroundCraft
description: It will be a big mod containing elements of survival, adventure, etc.
body:
![GroundCraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4d9a9ac3054838e8fedcacfd7f893a68e7de573.png)
 - This mod is inspired by the game **Grounded (2)** ->
 
   **Creators** of the game that I was inspired by and their game [(**Grounded**,](https://grounded.obsidian.net/) [ **Grounded 2**)](https://grounded2.obsidian.net/)

There will be a lot of bugs in this mod, and it will be updated rarely because I'm still learning programming/modding. For now it will stay like this - I would like to continue upgrading/updating it but I have 0 experience. I have big plans for this mod, so I hope it goes as planned.

=

 - **_This mod depends on:_**

1. [**Fabric API**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
2. [**GeckoLib**](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)

=

- **_Shaders are compatible but:_**
1. When wearing Red Ant Armor it appears twice, once as a little object on screen - because I didn't fix it and it appears on the player or whatever you put it on.
2. I used [**BSL Shaders**](https://modrinth.com/shader/bsl-shaders) but I'm pretty sure other shaders will work well too.

=

- **_Recommended:_**
1. Use the mod [**Model Gap Fix**](https://modrinth.com/mod/modelfix) so items (minecraft and mod items) look better

=

The description will change so don't worry... but bugs are always going to be a part of this mod!
